epic_name: SEO Site Onboarding & Keyword Discovery System with RuVector Intelligence
epic_description: Build comprehensive SEO onboarding workflow for new sites and automated keyword discovery pipeline. Leverages RuVector semantic search for intelligent caching, research reuse, and pattern learning. Creates holistic review process to analyze sites and generate data-driven keyword strategies with 80%+ cost reduction through intelligence reuse.

epic_goals.primary: Enable systematic site onboarding and automated keyword opportunity discovery with RuVector-powered intelligence
secondary: Complete site analysis in <5 days with 7-phase pipeline
Discover 50+ keyword opportunities per discovery run
80%+ cost reduction through RuVector research reuse
75%+ time savings for content clusters via cached intelligence
Self-improving patterns via performance feedback loop

success_metrics.adoption: Used for all new site engagements

ruvector_integration.description: RuVector provides semantic search and persistent intelligence storage for SEO workflows

expert_sources.purpose: Store expert quotes, sources, and citations for content enrichment
expert_sources.reuse: Reuse expert quotes across articles in same niche

statistics.purpose: Cache statistics, data points, and numerical facts
statistics.reuse: Reuse validated statistics across content pieces

keyword_research.purpose: Store keyword research results with volume, difficulty, intent
keyword_research.reuse: Skip API calls for previously researched keywords

competitor_intelligence.purpose: Cache competitor analysis, strategies, and patterns
competitor_intelligence.reuse: Reuse competitor insights for same industry

serp_patterns.purpose: Store SERP features, ranking patterns, semantic clusters
serp_patterns.reuse: Apply proven SERP strategies to similar queries

content_patterns.purpose: Store successful content patterns and performance metrics

workflow_integration.step_0_preload: Query RuVector for cached intelligence before starting research
workflow_integration.step_4_5_storage: Store new research results in appropriate collections
workflow_integration.step_12_5_patterns: Extract successful patterns after content validation
workflow_integration.step_13_feedback: Update pattern confidence based on performance data

cost_savings.api_reduction: 80%+ reduction in DataForSEO API calls via caching
cost_savings.research_reuse: Skip redundant research for same niche/cluster
cost_savings.pattern_learning: Improve quality over time via feedback loop

deliverables.name: /seo-onboard Slash Command
deliverables.description: Create entry point command that accepts domain, competitors, and industry parameters
acceptance_criteria: Passes all parameters to coordinator with proper context
Includes usage examples and help text
Triggers RuVector pre-research query for cached intelligence

deliverables.name: seo-onboarding-coordinator Agent
deliverables.description: Coordinator agent that orchestrates all 7 phases of site onboarding with RuVector integration
acceptance_criteria: Spawns appropriate specialist agents for each phase
Collects and aggregates outputs from all phases
Handles phase failures gracefully with rollback
Stores results in Redis for retrieval
Integrates RuVector pre-research (Step 0) before each phase
Stores new findings in RuVector (Step 4.5 equivalent) after each phase
Extracts patterns for future reuse after successful completion

deliverables.name: RuVector SEO Onboarding Collections
deliverables.description: Define RuVector collection schemas for onboarding-specific data

Cross-site pattern collection (successful strategies by industry)
deliverables.completion_note: Schemas 100% complete (1,167 lines TypeScript). RuVector client functions (upsertSiteProfile, queryCrossSitePatterns, logOnboardingResult) deferred to Sprint 1.2 due to security priority (SEC-1.1 through SEC-1.6). Backlog item P2-002 created.

sprints.sprint_goal: Implement Technical Foundation, Content Inventory, and Competitor Discovery phases with RuVector intelligence reuse

deliverables.name: Phase 1: Technical Foundation Module with Caching
deliverables.description: Site crawl, Core Web Vitals, indexability audit with RuVector pattern reuse
acceptance_criteria: Pre-check: Query RuVector for existing site profile
Site crawl captures all pages (uses sitemap + discovery)
Core Web Vitals assessment via PageSpeed Insights API
Indexability audit (robots.txt, meta robots, canonical tags)

deliverables.name: Phase 2: Content Inventory Module with Pattern Matching
deliverables.description: Map existing content, classify types, match against successful content patterns
acceptance_criteria: Pre-check: Query content_patterns collection for industry benchmarks
Crawl all pages and extract metadata
Classify content by type (blog, product, service, landing)
Extract existing target keywords from title tags and H1s
Measure content depth (word count, headings, media)
Compare against successful patterns from RuVector
Identify thin content (<300 words) and duplicates
Post-phase: Store content inventory metadata in RuVector

deliverables.name: Phase 3: Competitor Discovery Module with Intelligence Reuse
deliverables.description: Identify and analyze competitors, reusing cached competitor intelligence
acceptance_criteria: Pre-check: Query competitor_intelligence for cached analysis
Auto-discover competitors from SERP if not provided
